format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

probes.title: open answers applied: the panel is a menu named by the language file's label, its rows menuitemradio

steps.script: (() => { const p = document.getElementById('pp'); p.profiles = [{id: 'regular', label: 'Обычный', shared: true, builtin: true}, {id: 'editors', label: 'Редакторы', shared: true}, {id: 'mine', label: 'Мой', shared: false}]; p.rights = {create: {personal: false, shared: true}}; return true; })()

steps.check: (() => { const panel = document.querySelector('#pp .sf-profile-picker-panel'); return panel.getAttribute('role') === 'menu' && panel.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Профиль' && panel.querySelectorAll('[role="menuitemradio"]').length === 3 && document.querySelector('#pp [aria-checked="true"]').dataset.id === 'regular'; })()
